title: UAAP: NUNS sweeps UST, rises to solo lead in girls' volleyball
summary: National University-Nazareth School claimed the solo lead in the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament after a comprehensive victory over University of Santo Tomas on Tuesday.
